title: Poor Man's Agentic Modeling: Simulating Large LLM-Agent Societies on a Laptop

live_model.evidence: "We fit beta(N) by maximum likelihood from real decisions elicited with their verbatim prompt across six models"; Table 3 row GPT-4-Turbo: betaeff trend="slow decay", our Nc~1600

prompt.note: The paper states it reuses "their [De Marzo et al./EconAgent's] verbatim prompt" but does not reprint that prompt text; the only appendix (D) is a mathematical proof.

claim.metric: critical group size Nc (naming-game consensus threshold)

data.source: De Marzo et al. naming-game task; EconAgent household prompts (external, cited sources)

notes: This is a low-cost replication/reanalysis of De Marzo et al. and EconAgent using cloned surrogate models plus spot checks on real APIs (GPT-4-Turbo, GPT-4o, Llama-3.3-70B, DeepSeek, plus futuristic-sounding 'Opus-4.8'/'GLM-5.2'); reproducing it requires the source papers' prompts, which are cited but not reproduced here.
